name: Databento
desc: Provides historical and real-time financial market data through standardized APIs for traders, asset managers and AI labs.
capacity_detail: USD 100M Series C led by Fifth Down Capital at a USD 1.1bn valuation (12 Nov 2026); total raised USD 234.6M
markets: Quant trading firms, brokerages, asset managers and AI labs; infrastructure at exchanges and data centres in US, Europe and Asia-Pacific

signals.raise: USD 100M Series C at USD 1.1bn valuation led by Fifth Down Capital (Nov 2026; https://databento.com/blog/series-c)

rationale: Newly minted fintech-data unicorn selling to trading firms and brokers; F1's finance-heavy hospitality audience matches its institutional buyers.

name: Corma
desc: Builds AI foundation models and autonomous agents for defensive cybersecurity that work alongside companies' existing security tools.
ownership: private, owner not stated (venture-backed: NEA, Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, Coatue)
capacity_detail: USD 125M Series A led by NEA at a USD 1bn valuation (16 Nov 2026); total raised USD 185M
markets: Fortune 100 and Global 500 companies in healthcare, finance, energy, retail and telecoms; offices in San Francisco and Tel Aviv

signals.raise: USD 125M Series A at USD 1bn valuation led by NEA (Nov 2026; https://thenextweb.com/news/corma-series-a-125m-1bn-valuation-nea)

rationale: Cybersecurity rivals CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Cato Networks and Bitdefender already use F1 to reach enterprise buyers; Corma could follow as it scales.

name: Mailchimp
desc: Email marketing automation platform for businesses, founded in Atlanta in 2001 and serving millions of customers worldwide.
ownership: subsidiary of Intuit; definitive agreement (19 Nov 2026) to sell it to Bending Spoons, close expected early 2027
capacity_detail: Agreed sale to Bending Spoons for about USD 3.68bn (USD 3.31bn cash plus USD 368M Bending Spoons stock), Nov 2026; Q1 FY2027 revenue USD 313M
markets: Small and mid-sized businesses worldwide; millions of customers around the world
rationale: Consumer-facing SME marketing brand facing new ownership; rival software brands use F1 for global visibility and B2B hospitality.

name: Ramon.Space
desc: Builds space-resilient computing platforms providing compute, storage and connectivity for satellite and deep-space missions.
ownership: private, owner not stated (venture-backed: PSG, Micron Technology, Senvest, Phoenix Financial)
capacity_detail: USD 124M Series B led by PSG (Nov 2026), taking total raised to USD 167.5M
markets: Satellite and deep-space mission operators; space computing infrastructure

signals.raise: USD 124M Series B led by PSG (Nov 2026; https://news.crunchbase.com/venture/biggest-startup-rounds-science-neurotech-model-ml-galvanize-therapeutics/)

rationale: Deep-tech hardware supplier with a mostly B2B government and satellite customer base; F1 engineering partnerships are a plausible but narrow fit.
